layout.leaf_order: zero-based; field and subfield numeric IDs ascending; casefolded display name then author ID
layout.internal_angle: midpoint of first and last descendant leaf angles on the unwrapped circle
layout.coordinates: angle starts at top, increases clockwise; x_norm=r*sin(angle), y_norm=-r*cos(angle). Screen point = (cx+R*x_norm, cy+R*y_norm).
layout.labels: Use field sector labels and a keyed legend for long names or narrow sectors. Put subfield names and full author labels in hover/focus or selection to avoid collisions. Derive sector bounds halfway to neighboring leaves, including across the wrap.

routing.control_points: JSON.parse(edge.route_ids_json), look up each ID by hierarchy_id, then project x_norm/y_norm to screen. Draw in given order with d3.line().x(d => d.x).y(d => d.y).curve(d3.curveBundle.beta(0.75)).
routing.lca: LCA is included once: root for inter_field, field for within_field_between_subfields, subfield for same_subfield. The curve is smoothed and need not pass through internal controls.

styling.default: Draw all edges at equal base width. Use muted neutral grays at lower opacity for within-field classes; draw inter-field ties on top in a higher-contrast accent. Keep isolates visible on the ring.
styling.interaction: Hover/focus author or field pair to highlight exact ties and dim the rest; sync author selections to V1 using author_id if supported. Tooltip gives both endpoint names, taxonomy, relationship and original T2 shared-work weight. Never use bundle darkness as an exact count; show T13 counts.
styling.summary: Show largest-component callout and full-network totals. Pair ranks use tie count desc, then numeric field IDs asc; expand beyond the leading pairs using the complete table.
